criteria.title: Clean import
criteria.procedure: Extract into a clean workspace and import the new game project.
criteria.expected: No missing scripts/assets and no unacknowledged engine-version mismatch.
criteria.note: Fresh copy (no .godot cache) imported headless; the first pass logs the usual font-before-import notice, the second pass is clean.

criteria.title: No accidental replacement
criteria.procedure: Start in a workspace containing unrelated files.
criteria.expected: Agent inventories existing work and does not overwrite it.
criteria.note: The connected folder held only the two handoff markdown files; nothing there was overwritten (deliverables go to new subfolders).

criteria.title: Content compiler coverage
criteria.procedure: Compile every catalog record.
criteria.expected: Unknown effects, missing assets and unresolved refs fail clearly; no silent Attack fallback.
criteria.note: Compiler fails on unknown ops, refs, maps, scenes, ragged grids; --strict fails on pending location refs.

criteria.title: Acquisition coverage
criteria.procedure: Trace every weapon, armor, accessory, summon and required item source.
criteria.expected: All mandatory content has a reachable guaranteed path; unique optional rewards have defined sources.
criteria.note: Starter kits, shops (by chapter tier), chests, quests and salvage cover the catalog; no automated per-item source trace yet.

criteria.title: New game route
criteria.procedure: Start at Title with normal keyboard input.
criteria.expected: Reach Brackenford and control Dain without debug commands.
criteria.note: B1 route: Title -> New Game -> Brackenford with normal input.

criteria.title: Controller-only session
criteria.procedure: Navigate title, exploration, battle, equipment and save with a controller.
criteria.expected: No mouse/keyboard-only dead end or lost focus.
criteria.note: Joypad buttons/axes are bound for every action; no physical controller session was run.

criteria.title: Native-resolution text
criteria.procedure: Inspect every major panel at 320×240 and scaled window sizes.
criteria.expected: No clipping, unreadable required labels or off-screen confirm/cancel controls.
criteria.note: Captures reviewed at 320x240; long objective toasts now wrap. Not every panel was inspected at every scale.

criteria.title: Remapping and focus loss
criteria.procedure: Change key bindings, lose focus, return and restart.
criteria.expected: Bindings persist and the default focus pause works.
criteria.note: Rebinding and pause-on-focus-loss are implemented and persisted; not exercised by an automated test.

criteria.title: Reduced effects
criteria.procedure: Disable shake/flashes, shorten summons and mute sound.
criteria.expected: Critical tells and puzzles remain understandable.
criteria.note: Shake/flash toggles and volume exist; tells are text + icon so they survive reduced effects. Not separately play-tested.

criteria.title: Doorway graph
criteria.procedure: Traverse every authored doorway through actual collision geometry.
criteria.expected: Every endpoint has a safe spawn and lawful return path.
criteria.note: Offline: every entity reachable and every arrival spawn reaches every exit of its room. Runtime: all story doorways crossed by the chained routes.

criteria.title: Puzzle reset
criteria.procedure: Make incorrect operations at every required puzzle.
criteria.expected: A reset or recovery remains reachable without rare consumables.
criteria.note: Wrong valve/relay/dial/bell choices reset or explain without consuming items; verified by design review and partly by routes (not every wrong input automated).

criteria.title: Y-sort and collision
criteria.procedure: Walk behind roofs, beside props and through doors.
criteria.expected: Feet align, actors sort correctly and interaction targets are unambiguous.
criteria.note: Y-sorted actors/props and door interaction verified in captures; no systematic sweep.

criteria.title: Encounter meter
criteria.procedure: Wait in menus, push against a wall and operate a switch.
criteria.expected: None advances encounter distance; post-battle grace remains.
criteria.note: Meter advances only on completed steps on encounter terrain; menus/switches/wall pushes cannot step. Not unit-tested.

criteria.title: Landing failure
criteria.procedure: Attempt landing outside a valid zone and reload a valid parked position.
criteria.expected: No lost ship or invalid foot spawn.
criteria.note: test_post_state::test_landing_needs_marked_field.

criteria.title: Fixed-step determinism
criteria.procedure: Replay the same seed and public command stream at different render rates.
criteria.expected: Same authoritative action, damage, reward and end-state hashes.
criteria.note: test_battle_core::test_fixed_step_determinism.

criteria.title: Wait vs Active
criteria.procedure: Open target selection in both modes.
criteria.expected: Wait pauses simulation timers; Active advances them; pause menu freezes both.
criteria.note: test_battle_core::test_wait_vs_active.

criteria.title: MP reservation
criteria.procedure: Rapidly confirm/cancel and then allow one spell to resolve.
criteria.expected: Exactly one valid MP charge; invalid/canceled actions consume none.
criteria.note: test_battle_core::test_mp_reservation.

criteria.title: Item reservation
criteria.procedure: Two allies select the last Phoenix Leaf before resolution.
criteria.expected: Only one valid reservation; no negative inventory or duplicate revive.
criteria.note: test_battle_core::test_item_reservation_last_phoenix.

criteria.title: Fallen target retarget
criteria.procedure: KO an intended damage/heal target before another committed action resolves.
criteria.expected: Documented retarget/refund rules apply and are logged.
criteria.note: test_battle_core::test_fallen_target_retarget, test_revive_refund_when_no_fallen.

criteria.title: Actor KO while casting
criteria.procedure: KO a caster before resolution.
criteria.expected: Turn is lost, reserved cost restored and no phantom spell occurs.
criteria.note: test_battle_core::test_actor_ko_while_casting_refunds.

criteria.title: Simultaneous wipe
criteria.procedure: Cause legal simultaneous last-enemy and last-player KO.
criteria.expected: Defeat-priority rule applies consistently; reward transaction is not committed.
criteria.note: test_battle_core::test_simultaneous_wipe_defeat_priority.

criteria.title: Status duration
criteria.procedure: Exercise all sixteen statuses through actions and skipped opportunities.
criteria.expected: No infinite stun, repeated DOT from animation frames or leaked exploration poison.
criteria.note: test_battle_core::test_status_durations_and_hard_control, test_haste_slow_exclusive, test_boss_immunities_and_delay_cap.

criteria.title: Defense stacking
criteria.procedure: Combine oath, Defend, Barrier and accessories.
criteria.expected: Direct reduction caps correctly; no accidental invulnerability or negative damage.
criteria.note: test_battle_core::test_defense_stacking_cap.

criteria.title: Reaction recursion
criteria.procedure: Use counter, interception, reflection and a multi-hit enemy action.
criteria.expected: Trigger caps honor origin action IDs; no counter-counter loop.
criteria.note: test_battle_core::test_counter_no_recursion.

criteria.title: Dain oaths
criteria.procedure: Switch every oath, take protection hits and approach 1 HP.
criteria.expected: One oath only; transfers obey nonlethal and per-action caps.
criteria.note: test_battle_roles::test_dain_oaths_exclusive_and_sacrifice_caps, test_shelter_intercepts_low_ally_once.

criteria.title: Tessa Overcast
criteria.procedure: Arm, cancel, cast, fail target validation and repeat recovery actions.
criteria.expected: Documented costs, nonlethal self-damage and Heat Exchange limits hold.
criteria.note: test_battle_roles::test_tessa_overcast_costs_and_nonlethal, test_heat_exchange_limits.

criteria.title: Corren airborne
criteria.procedure: KO grounded allies while Corren is in flight; pause and resume.
criteria.expected: Battle waits for his lawful landing and does not softlock.
criteria.note: test_battle_roles::test_corren_airborne_no_softlock.

criteria.title: Ivo devices
criteria.procedure: Reapply a mine, destroy a decoy and revive Ivo.
criteria.expected: No duplicate mine, stale decoy or reset of once-per-battle engine use.
criteria.note: test_battle_roles::test_ivo_mine_and_decoy.

criteria.title: Nera knowledge
criteria.procedure: Mark and inspect a new enemy, win, reload and inspect bestiary.
criteria.expected: Discovered information persists without granting unrelated drops.
criteria.note: test_battle_roles::test_nera_mark_bonus_not_multiplied; bestiary persistence covered by save round trip, not a dedicated test.

criteria.title: Oriel intent
criteria.procedure: Inspect an enemy with and without a committed move.
criteria.expected: Only actual committed intent is shown; no invented future RNG result.
criteria.note: test_battle_roles::test_oriel_omen_reads_only_committed.

criteria.title: Sable infusion
criteria.procedure: Change infusion, remove accessory magic, dispel a boss.
criteria.expected: One infusion; removable buffs only; no deletion of phase scripts.
criteria.note: test_battle_roles::test_sable_single_infusion.

criteria.title: Pip transactions
criteria.procedure: Steal repeatedly, use last item with Quick Hands, then retry a loss.
criteria.expected: Steal caps, item counts and retry rollback hold.
criteria.note: test_battle_roles::test_pip_steal_caps.

criteria.title: Concord accounting
criteria.procedure: Use area/multi-hit actions, Defend, Seeds and summons.
criteria.expected: Action-based gain caps and once-per-battle limits hold; no self-generating summon loop.
criteria.note: test_battle_core::test_concord_accounting.

criteria.title: Unique links
criteria.procedure: Attempt duplicate Vestige links and link from unavailable members.
criteria.expected: Ownership/availability rules hold and reassignment at safe screens works.
criteria.note: test_campaign::test_vestige_unique_links.

criteria.title: Two-handed swap
criteria.procedure: Equip/unequip every weapon type with a full inventory.
criteria.expected: Offhand returns safely; no duplication or lost unique item.
criteria.note: test_campaign::test_two_handed_swap_returns_offhand.

criteria.title: Stats and grant removal
criteria.procedure: Compare UI preview to battle; remove a spell-grant accessory.
criteria.expected: Derived stats match and temporary spell access disappears.
criteria.note: test_battle_roles::test_accessory_spell_removed_with_accessory; test_formulas::test_equipment_change_does_not_regrow.

criteria.title: Shop boundaries
criteria.procedure: Buy with exact gold, insufficient gold and a 99-item stack.
criteria.expected: Prices/capacity validated before payment; no underflow.
criteria.note: test_campaign::test_shop_boundaries; test_post_state::test_every_shop_lists_stock_at_every_stage (regression for the tier-key crash found by the seg8 route).

criteria.title: Full-inventory reward
criteria.procedure: Complete a personal quest with no ordinary capacity.
criteria.expected: Unique reward enters delivery storage and completion remains consistent.
criteria.note: test_campaign::test_unique_overflow_goes_to_delivery.

criteria.title: Reserve growth
criteria.procedure: Win battles with unavailable members and trigger a reunion twice.
criteria.expected: XP is correct; growth and starter gear do not duplicate.
criteria.note: test_campaign::test_reserve_growth_and_reunion; test_formulas::test_join_level.

criteria.title: Round trip
criteria.procedure: Save and reload at town, field, ship and pre-boss locations.
criteria.expected: Relevant state matches with safe spawn and correct music/availability.
criteria.note: test_campaign::test_save_round_trip; B1 saves at a lamp, returns to title and reloads through the menu. Ship/pre-boss reloads not separately automated.

criteria.title: Corrupt primary
criteria.procedure: Corrupt a disposable test copy of a save.
criteria.expected: Backup recovery offered; corrupt copy retained; no silent new game.
criteria.note: test_campaign::test_corrupt_primary_offers_backup.

criteria.title: Future schema
criteria.procedure: Load a deliberately newer schema fixture.
criteria.expected: Clear unsupported-version response; no destructive overwrite.
criteria.note: test_campaign::test_future_schema_rejected.

criteria.title: Crash during write
criteria.procedure: Inject process interruption at controlled disposable save-write stages.
criteria.expected: Either old or new complete state loads; no partial hybrid.
criteria.note: test_campaign::test_crash_during_write_keeps_complete_state.

criteria.title: Skipped scene equivalence
criteria.procedure: Play and skip each major scene from equivalent fixtures.
criteria.expected: Same authoritative committed state and rewards.
criteria.note: test_story::test_skip_equivalence.

criteria.title: Duplicate trigger
criteria.procedure: Re-enter a chapter/quest trigger after completion.
criteria.expected: No repeated reward, party join or world transition.
criteria.note: test_story::test_once_scene_not_reapplied; test_post_state::test_personal_quest_reward_once.

criteria.title: Pre-catastrophe campaign
criteria.procedure: Use normal input from New Game through CH11.
criteria.expected: All required locations, recruits and bosses work without flag edits.
criteria.note: Normal-input chain: b1 (New Game..CH01) -> seg2 -> seg3 -> seg4 -> seg5 (CH11, then CH12), each segment resuming from the milestone the previous one wrote. No flag edits in routes.

criteria.title: Catastrophe preservation
criteria.procedure: Transition with mixed gear, quests, loot, chest and reserve states.
criteria.expected: CH12 changes phase atomically and preserves specified ownership/state.
criteria.note: test_campaign::test_catastrophe_transaction_preserves_ownership; test_post_state::test_catastrophe_scene_commits_post_state; seg5 reaches Hearthward through the real scene.

criteria.title: Sealed-map salvage
criteria.procedure: Skip a unique pre-state reward, then complete CH12.
criteria.expected: Salvage delivers it once; already acquired copies are not duplicated.
criteria.note: test_campaign::test_salvage_forwarding_once.

criteria.title: Recovery route
criteria.procedure: Play CH13–CH16 at expected resource/level floor.
criteria.expected: Two/three/four-person sections are viable and Wayfarer is earned normally.
criteria.note: seg6: CH13-CH16 with the two-, three- and four-person party; Wayfarer earned in play.

criteria.title: Six reunion orders
criteria.procedure: Run all six permutations of CH17, CH18 and CH19 from the ship checkpoint.
criteria.expected: No dependency cycle, absent-person dialogue or missing CH20 unlock.
criteria.note: test_post_state::test_reunion_orders_all_six runs the real completion scenes in all six orders; the routes play one order (CH17, CH18, CH19) end to end.

criteria.title: Personal quests
criteria.procedure: Complete each of Q01–Q08 and reload at each stage.
criteria.expected: Exact weapon/ability rewards, world changes and epilogue flags occur once.
criteria.note: segq plays Q01-Q08 to COMPLETED with normal input (rewards and final techniques granted); reload at every stage is covered only by the quest-state tests, not per stage in play.

criteria.title: Optional bosses
criteria.procedure: Complete Q09–Q12, flee attempts and loss/retry paths.
criteria.expected: Boss gating, rewards and optional status are correct.
criteria.note: segq defeats B13, B14, B15 and B16 (Q12 before the final commitment) and receives V07, V08, A023, A024; defeat/Retry paths occurred in dev runs.

criteria.title: Two-party formations
criteria.procedure: Try representative balanced and legal unbalanced splits of all eight.
criteria.expected: Both routes are solvable with available items and recovery; no inventory duplication.
criteria.note: seg8 plays the default balanced split; unbalanced splits are allowed by the split screen (healer warning) but not route-tested.

criteria.title: Cross-party locks
criteria.procedure: Change teams, reload and approach the shared gate in both orders.
criteria.expected: No one-way lock traps the other team; route state persists.
criteria.note: test_post_state::test_team_locks_alternate_without_trapping.

criteria.title: Final phase thresholds
criteria.procedure: Cross B12 thresholds with large and multi-hit attacks.
criteria.expected: Each phase starts once; one boss reward and correct ending transition.
criteria.note: test_battle_core::test_boss_phase_threshold_once; B12 fought in seg8.

criteria.title: Zero-optionals ending
criteria.procedure: Finish the main route without CH21 or optional quests.
criteria.expected: Complete valid ending; no missing final key or false bad-ending label.
criteria.note: seg8 finishes CH22-CH24 with zero optional quests; the ending, credits and clear save complete.

criteria.title: Epilogue combinations
criteria.procedure: Test none, all, each personal flag alone and one mixed set.
criteria.expected: Correct base/enhanced scenes; no unavailable actors or contradictory lines.
criteria.note: Each epilogue line branches on its quest flag; only the zero-quest combination is route-played.

criteria.title: Post-clear return
criteria.procedure: Return from credits to before the final descent.
criteria.expected: Safe pre-finale snapshot, clear flag and completed optional content retained.
criteria.note: seg8 chooses Continue from Before the Final Descent and lands at the Accord Dock with the post_clear flag.

criteria.title: Sprite contact sheets
criteria.procedure: Inspect every hero direction and battle frame in a contact sheet and runtime.
criteria.expected: No inconsistent identity, jitter, misplaced weapon or empty required animation.
criteria.note: Generated sprites reviewed by the agent only; status 'generated', not final art.

criteria.title: Distinct locations
criteria.procedure: Review all towns and dungeons in actual captures.
criteria.expected: No placeholder geometry disguised as final art or identical room stamping.
criteria.note: Every location has its own composition; art is programmatic and plain in places.

criteria.title: Cue transitions
criteria.procedure: Enter/leave houses, start/retry battles, pause and change buses.
criteria.expected: No clicks, unwanted restarts, clipping, mute leaks or missing critical cues.
criteria.note: Cue switching implemented; no listening test (headless audio is a dummy driver).

criteria.title: Normal route pacing
criteria.procedure: Play representative early/mid/late sequences without debug resources.
criteria.expected: Record encounter time, resource use, level and failures; revise bottlenecks without inventing measured total playtime.
criteria.note: Route traces record level, battles and resources per segment; the bot takes direct paths, so it is a lower bound for play time.

criteria.title: Ordinary encounters off
criteria.procedure: Use the documented accessibility mode through a campaign segment.
criteria.expected: Milestone progression or offered training keeps the route viable; story bosses remain.
criteria.note: level_floor milestone growth exists for encounters-off; no campaign segment run in that mode.

criteria.title: Clean-source build
criteria.procedure: Import and export a fresh copy at the tested revision.
criteria.expected: No dependence on untracked files or author-machine absolute paths.
criteria.note: Clean copy imported and exported the Windows build with no author-machine paths.

criteria.title: Windows export launch
criteria.procedure: Launch the produced Windows executable on Windows.
criteria.expected: Actual platform smoke and save/load results recorded; cross-export alone is not a pass.
criteria.note: Build copied to the owner's folder and checksum-verified there; it was not launched on Windows (computer use could not run an unregistered executable).

criteria.title: Asset provenance
criteria.procedure: Audit every bundled asset, dependency and credit.
criteria.expected: Source/permission recorded; no ripped commercial assets or undocumented font files.
criteria.note: All art/audio/font generated by project code; Godot MIT license and third-party notices bundled.

criteria.title: Evidence freshness
criteria.procedure: Compare source/content hashes to test and screenshot records.
criteria.expected: Claims refer to the packaged revision; stale artifacts are rejected.
criteria.note: Final chain, runtime tests and clean-archive export all ran on revision 7428b37 / content e528220ab0ff6194 (logs print the content hash).

criteria.title: Human quality review
criteria.procedure: Have the owner or a separate tester play the exported opening and finale.
criteria.expected: Record feedback honestly; agent self-review is not reported as external approval.
criteria.note: Needs the owner or a separate human tester; agent self-review is not a substitute.
